name: POX OS
description: POX OS is our core operating system built on clean AOSP sources with curated stability patches, strict background memory management, and zero unnecessary bloatware.

tutorial.title: Unlock Bootloader & Backup Data
tutorial.instruction: Enable Developer Options and OEM Unlocking in Android Settings. Backup your files, reboot into fastboot mode, and unlock the bootloader.

tutorial.title: Flash POX Recovery Image
tutorial.instruction: Download the verified POX Recovery image matching your phone codename and flash it via fastboot.

tutorial.title: Format Data & Boot to Recovery
tutorial.instruction: Reboot into POX Recovery and select Format Data / Factory Reset to remove previous encryption.

tutorial.title: Sideload POX OS Release Package
tutorial.instruction: Select Apply Update -> Apply from ADB in recovery, then sideload the signed POX OS zip package.

features.title: Clean AOSP base
features.text: Stays close to upstream with only curated patches, so updates stay predictable.

features.title: Strict memory control
features.text: Background processes are capped to keep the phone smooth after days of uptime.

features.title: Zero bloatware
features.text: No preinstalled extras. You decide what goes on your phone.

name: POX KERNEL
description: An upstreamed, LTO-optimized Linux kernel featuring custom energy scheduling, reduced idle drain, and consistent frame pacing under sustained load.

tutorial.title: Verify Current Firmware Base
tutorial.instruction: Ensure your device is running a compatible Android version and vendor partition before flashing POX Kernel.

tutorial.title: Reboot to Recovery
tutorial.instruction: Connect your phone via USB and reboot into recovery mode.

tutorial.title: Sideload POX Kernel Zip
tutorial.instruction: Flash the signed POX Kernel AnyKernel3 archive via ADB sideload.

features.title: LTO optimized
features.text: Link time optimization gives faster and smaller builds.

features.title: Energy aware scheduling
features.text: Lower idle drain with consistent frame pacing under load.

features.title: Upstream first
features.text: Regular merges from the latest stable Linux releases.

name: POX RECOVERY
description: A minimalist recovery environment engineered for seamless OTA updates, fast ADB sideloading, and reliable decryption across modern partitions.
supportedPhones: Xiaomi Redmi K60 / POCO F5 Pro (mondrian)

tutorial.title: Enter Fastboot Mode
tutorial.instruction: Power off your device and hold Volume Down + Power until the Fastboot screen appears.

tutorial.title: Flash Recovery Partition
tutorial.instruction: Flash the POX Recovery image to the recovery or vendor_boot partition.

tutorial.title: Reboot into POX Recovery
tutorial.instruction: Boot directly into the recovery interface to verify installation.

features.title: Fast sideload
features.text: Flash updates over ADB without waiting on slow transfers.

features.title: Reliable decryption
features.text: Works across modern partition layouts and encryption schemes.

features.title: Minimal interface
features.text: Only what you need to install, back up and recover.

name: POX GUARD
description: System-level permission and background wakelock sentinel that blocks rogue processes and enforces strict firewall policies with zero overhead.

tutorial.title: Verify Signed Package
tutorial.instruction: Fetch the verified POX Guard release package from the official GitHub repository.

tutorial.title: Install via ADB
tutorial.instruction: Install the package directly onto your device using ADB.

tutorial.title: Enable Background Stability Profile
tutorial.instruction: Grant background control permission and activate the default stability profile.
tutorial.command: adb shell cmd appops set com.pox.guard RUN_IN_BACKGROUND allow

features.title: Wakelock sentinel
features.text: Detects and stops rogue background wakelocks before they drain the battery.

features.title: Firewall policies
features.text: Per-app network rules enforced at system level.

features.title: Zero overhead
features.text: Runs as a lightweight system service with no measurable cost.

name: POX CAMERA
description: A lightweight camera app tuned for stable shots and fast startup on supported devices.

tutorial.title: Download the APK
tutorial.instruction: Grab the signed release from the GitHub releases page.

tutorial.title: Grant permissions
tutorial.instruction: Open the app and allow camera and storage access.

features.title: Fast startup
features.text: Opens and is ready to shoot in under a second.

features.title: Stable processing
features.text: Tuned pipelines that avoid crashes during long sessions.

features.title: Clean viewfinder
features.text: No filters or overlays unless you turn them on.

name: POX LAUNCHER
description: A minimal launcher that keeps your home screen fast, quiet and out of the way.

tutorial.title: Download the APK
tutorial.instruction: Get the latest release from GitHub.

tutorial.title: Set as default
tutorial.instruction: Press Home and choose POX Launcher as your default launcher.

features.title: Quiet home screen

features.title: Instant search

features.title: Light on memory
